author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.85 shipped: Room forecasts and next-room predictions use the dwell model
summary: Room forecasts and next-room predictions use the dwell model
why: The 10-21 prediction audit found no room prediction both useful and correct: forecasts came from a Bayesian arrivals model (AUC 0.603) while the dwell model scores AUC 0.835 on the same live samples, and next-room ignored the current room. Prune covered one type, so 177k stale rows accumulated.
implications: Shipped PREDICT-MODEL-DWELL-MIGRATION-1, PREDICT-SCORER-BASELINE-SKILL-1 at v5.103.85; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.85.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: After restart: dwell_share rows within 2h, skip_ratio_ok per resident, next_room rows older than 45 days = 0 after first nightly maintenance.

refs.release_notes: Room forecast/pattern sensors read RoomDwellModel (kill switch FORECAST_DWELL_SOURCE_ENABLED); hourly dwell_share scoring; next-room predicts from current room with skip_ratio guard; prune covers all prediction types at 45 days (first night removes ~150k old next_room rows, operator-approved); skill-vs-baseline scorers on accuracy sensors. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.85.md.
